title: Stadsherberg, Batavia
axis: Positive Z faces the former harbor canal to the west-southwest. Positive X runs south-southeast along the quay.
source: 1881 Dutch cadastral survey aligned to surviving Sunda Kelapa landmarks

mappedIdentity.name: Stadsherberg, Batavia
mappedIdentity.address: Historic east quay at the Kleine Boom, Sunda Kelapa, Jakarta, Indonesia

features.role: Reconstructed enclosure on the east quay from the nineteenth-century survey and historic photographs.

identityStatus: The cadastral print and two surviving navigation landmarks fix the former east quay. The panorama locates the inn relative to the landing pavilion. The model uses a photo-derived footprint with approximate rear proportions.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the reconstructed west entrance. The low masonry plinth meets the current elevation of the historic quay block.

notes: Rijksmuseum period photographs show an eight-column waterfront veranda, balustraded cornice, a sign, tiled hipped roofs and a later shallow awning.
